title: Decide the error reporting surface: in-session error banner with a "Tell us about it" report action
decision: Errors that occur during a session shall be surfaced to the affected player as a clear, in-session error message presented within the session's chat-style surface, accompanied by a "Tell us about it" action that lets the player submit a report of the failure from the same surface, without leaving the session.
rationale: The founder decided that failures must show "a clear error message with a 'Tell us about it' button", with the stated reason that this way the team will be notified of bugs and improve. That decision fixes both halves of the surface: the message must be clear and player-visible, and the report action must be attached to it rather than living in a separate support channel. Placing the message and the report action inside the session surface keeps the player in the turn loop, which matters because a session is a continuous shared experience across several screens and any detour out of the session would break the shared state for that player. The chat-style visual identity the founder also chose makes an inline message plus an attached action the natural, already-familiar pattern, so no new interaction vocabulary is introduced. A report action co-located with the failure also captures the failure at the moment it is observed, which is what makes the notification useful for improving the product.

options_considered.option: A blocking modal dialog that interrupts the session until the player dismisses it
options_considered.reason: It guarantees the message is seen, but it halts the shared turn loop for one player while the rest of the group continues, which conflicts with the requirement that every connected player stays at the same point in the turn loop.

options_considered.option: A silent log or telemetry-only capture with no player-visible message
options_considered.reason: It would notify the team, but it fails the founder's decision that the player sees a clear error message, and the player would have no way to report what they were doing when it failed.

options_considered.option: A separate support or feedback page reached by navigating away from the session
options_considered.reason: It separates the report from the failure context and forces the player out of the session, losing the state they were in when the error occurred.

options_considered.option: An out-of-band channel such as email or an external issue tracker as the only reporting route
options_considered.reason: It adds a step the player will usually skip and depends on a destination outside the application, which conflicts with the requirement that the application operate self-contained.
